_comment: DRAFT (dialogue-drafts lane 2026-07-06, NOT wired). 'The Price of a Favor' — headman give-beat + suspicion arc. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-riverfarm-design.md §2/§3/§4. Voice contract: character-profiles-staging.md 'The headman' (suspicious-then-warmer, farm metaphors, swallows apologies halfway). Speaker 'Aldern' = ORIGINAL+flag (canon Riverfarm has Prost — deliberately NOT used, see headman.md). Reward gold flagged OPEN.

hub.speaker: Aldern
hub.text: You came through the door-magic, from the Drake city. Good — strangers see straight. Look at the fields on your way in? Grey at the roots. Wet-rot in a dry week. That's not weather. That's the hollow.

text_variants.text: A debt. One of OURS bought witch-work and let the bill sour. ...Chickens come home. I hate when they do that.
Fields turned green as first hay, overnight. I said hard words about the hollow this spring. I— hm. Well. The words are lying where I dropped them, and I won't be picking them up in front of you.
Barley's up, ledger's happy, and the village owes a stranger. That last one I don't mind writing down.

options.text: It's not a curse. It's a debt — one of your own bought a favor and won't pay it.
The blight's done. The debt's settled.

give.speaker: Aldern
give.text: We don't truck with witches. ...We didn't USE to. Everyone's something these days — the smith's boy has a [Class] for whistling, near enough. Go up to the hollow. Ask her price to leave off, or find what's truly eating the fields. I'll trust a stranger's eyes over my own temper. Barely. It's close.

options.text: I'll go up and hear her out.
Why not send your own people?

own_people.speaker: Aldern
own_people.text: Sent two. One came back talking about tea. The other came back ENGAGED to be married — no, I don't know either, and I've stopped asking. A village argues like family. A stranger gets to just argue.

give_coda.speaker: Aldern
give_coda.text: Take the cart track past the fences and mind the bent trees — the hollow starts where they start leaning in to listen. And traveler: drink what she pours you. Whatever I think of the craft, bad guesting is bad guesting.

suspicion.speaker: Aldern
suspicion.text: Bought. BOUGHT. Off the backs of everyone's barley— ...Which one? No. Don't tell me. If I know a name before the fields are green, I'll say something a headman can't unsay, and then I'm patching fences between families till frost. Settle it however it settles. I'll do my forgiving after harvest, when there's beer in it.

report.speaker: Aldern
report.text: Settled. Aye — the fields knew before you did. Rot's drying off the barley like dew off a... like dew. Eight gold: it's the village's, gathered fair, and you'll not wave it off. And about the witch — if she takes bread, we'll send bread. Quietly. A village remembers who lifted it. Even when it's embarrassed about the how.

options.text: Send the bread. She'll price it kindly.
